p.src: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David.

en: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David.

p.src: 1  I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

en: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”
u.src: 1  I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

p.src: 2  I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

en: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.
u.src: 2  I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

p.src: 3  My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

en: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
u.src: 3  My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

p.src: 4  “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

en: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
u.src: 4  “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

p.src: 5  Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

en: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.
u.src: 5  Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

p.src: 6  “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

en: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.
u.src: 6  “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

p.src: 7  Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

en: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
u.src: 7  Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

p.src: 8  Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

en: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
u.src: 8  Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

p.src: 9  I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

en: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
u.src: 9  I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

p.src: 10  Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

en: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
u.src: 10  Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

p.src: 11  When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

en: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.
u.src: 11  When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

p.src: 12  “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

en: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.
u.src: 12  “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

p.src: 13  Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”

en: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
u.src: 13  Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
